# Cedar External Access Standard
Synthetic acceptance fixture; repetition below forces a batch boundary.
Owner: Cedar Security.
## External access controls
Applicability: This section applies only to relationships in which counterparties process personal data. Every external control in this section has High severity.
External customer organizations consume Cedar services; external distribution partners resell those services. Cedar Security personnel are internal employees.
Cedar Security must maintain the internal approval register.
